INTRO_KR: The association was founded in 1972 when the timepiece industry in Taiwan was undergoing a transition from conducting retail and wholesale to assembling the timepieces. The lack of governing association gave rise to malignant competition causing chaos and price wars within the industry. The fortuitous establishment of the association by over 30 companies not only saved the industry but helped secure Taiwan's position as a leading producer of quality timepieces. Moreover, after operating in leased offices for more than 20 years, the association purchased its own office in 1992 and has since been able to offer a wider range of services to its members and affiliates.
